description: This Java source file defines the IniFileModel class, which manages reading and parsing an INI configuration file ('rusefi.ini') to extract dialog and field information, storing it in dialog models for use within the application.

classes.name: IniFileModel
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for reading and parsing the INI file, and providing access to dialog and field data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for testing; prints the dialogs map to standard output.

methods.name: readIniFile
methods.description: Reads the INI file and processes each line to build dialog models.

methods.name: finishDialog
methods.description: Finalizes the current dialog model and stores it in the dialogs map.

methods.name: handleLine
methods.description: Processes a line from the INI file, determining if it defines a dialog or a field.

methods.name: handleField
methods.description: Processes a 'field' line, creating a new field object and adding it to the current dialog's fields.

methods.name: handleDialog
methods.description: Processes a 'dialog' line, setting the current dialog's id and name.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes empty string tokens from the beginning of the token list.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IniFileModel.

methods.name: getDialogs
methods.description: Returns the map of dialog identifiers to DialogModel objects.
